survivors_flagged.one_line: Anglo American merger-of-equals: shareholders approved, ICA clearance in hand, final regulatory approvals guided Sept-2026 to Mar-2027 close - live dated arb into Anglo Teck.
Olanzapine LAI (TEV-'749) PDUFA in late 2026 after Feb-2026 NDA acceptance; real dated binary but small relative to a diversified $20B pharma, asymmetry not obviously mispriced.
~$225M debt-led financing package for G2_Austin phase 1 targeted mid-2026 with first cell production Q4-2026; binary funding milestone, but equity already ran +55% on the setup.

Tax-free separation into RemainCo (vascular/interventional/surgical) and NewCo (urology/acute/OEM) targeted for completion mid-2026, plus Biotronik vascular bolt-on; stock at multi-year lows into the split.
Pixclara (TLX101-Px) PDUFA set for Sept 11 2026 after prior CRL; real dated binary but modest revenue vs commercial Illuccix base, so asymmetry is limited.

Lightspeed fully funded (CAD 2.54B) with first two satellites slated to launch December 2026 — a dated make-or-break milestone against a deep NAV/debt-discount structure, but execution slippage risk is high.
$12.00 cash CrossCountry merger approved Jul 2, 2026, UWM bid defeated, close expected Aug 2026 - live but thin residual spread plus stub dividend.
Blackstone Infrastructure $61.25 cash deal; PUCT/FERC/FCC/HSR cleared, only NMPRC and NRC left, outside date extended to May 31 2027 - classic regulated-utility arb with a datable NMPRC docket.

verified.catalyst: China SAMR is the sole remaining regulatory condition to the Anglo American / Teck merger of equals (1.3301 Anglo shares per Teck share, court-approved plan of arrangement), with clearance and close guided Sept-2026 to Mar-2027.
verified.dated_milestone: SAMR Phase 3 in-depth decision pending (review opened Jun-2026); Teck mailed Letter of Transmittal/election form 2026-06-30; company-guided final approval window Sept-2026 through Mar-2027 — next hard date is the SAMR ruling, plausibly Q3-2026.
verified.instrument: Long TECK common; pure-spread expression is long TECK vs. short 1.3301 AAL.L per share
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named counterparty: Anglo American plc) + G2 (concrete commitment: signed, shareholder-approved, court-sanctioned plan of arrangement at a fixed 1.3301 ratio, settlement documents already mailed). G3 NOT met — I did not verify a specific currently-unpriced figure (no measured TECK/AAL spread in this pass).
verified.edge: M — the deal is public, approved by both shareholder bases, ICA-cleared and South Korea-cleared, so the residual is a single binary (SAMR) that the arb community already prices; edge exists only if the market over-discounts China risk, which I could not confirm without a spread measurement.
verified.primary_source: Teck news release "Teck Announces the Mailing of a Letter of Transmittal in Connection with the Merger of Equals with Anglo American," teck.com/merger, 2026-06-30; corroborated by MLex "Anglo American-Teck deal gets South Korea approval, only China remains" (2026) and Capitol Forum reporting that SAMR opened a Phase 3 in-depth review (Jun-2026); timeline from Anglo American guidance via MINING.COM (Mar-2026).
verified.kill_fact: Primary/near-primary sources confirm the load-bearing facts: Teck's own 2026-06-30 release (teck.com + GlobeNewswire) states the Letter of Transmittal and election form were mailed to registered Class A/Class B holders under a court-approved plan of arrangement, each Teck Share exchanging for 1.3301 Anglo ordinary shares (or 1.3301 Anglo Teck Exchangeco exchangeable shares for electing eligible Canadians); MLex confirms South Korea cleared and "only China remains"; Anglo/Teck management still guide close Sept-2026 to Mar-2027 (12-18 months from the Sept-2025 announcement). So the line is not FIRED and is not fabricated. CORRECTIONS: (1) The Capitol Forum reported (2026-06-11) SAMR escalated to an in-depth Phase 3 review with market surveys still running — Phase 3 plus the standard pull-and-refile mechanic pushes the realistic clearance mass toward the LATE end of the range, so calling the guidance unchanged understates that the distribution has shifted right; the "catalyst" is a ~6-month window, not a dated event, which is weak for ACTIVE tier. (2) The claimed Investment Canada Act clearance date of 2025-12-15 was not independently verified in this pass. (3) G3 remains unmet and is the decisive gap: with no measurement of the TECK vs. 1.3301x AAL.L spread, there is no evidence the SAMR binary is mispriced — this is one of the most widely followed mining arbs in the market, and an unmeasured spread on a well-telegraphed deal is a priced-in story, not an edge. Score cut 6 to 5 for the Phase 3 right-shift plus the range-not-date catalyst on top of the unproven edge.
verified.analysis: The triage claim checks out on the facts: both shareholder bases approved in Dec-2025, Investment Canada Act clearance landed 2025-12-15, South Korea has since cleared, and Teck mailed the Letter of Transmittal and election form on 2026-06-30 at a fixed 1.3301 Anglo-share ratio — so this is a live, dated, forward, non-macro arb with a named counterparty and a hard contractual commitment. The one open condition is China's SAMR, which escalated to an in-depth Phase 3 review in Jun-2026; management has not moved off its Sept-2026-to-Mar-2027 close guidance, meaning the catalyst is unfired but its date is a range, not a fixed day. I am scoring 6 rather than 7 because G3 is unmet in this pass: I did not measure the TECK vs. 1.3301x AAL spread, so I cannot assert the SAMR risk is mispriced — that spread reading is the gap to close before sizing, and it is also the difference between a genuine edge and simply owning a well-telegraphed deal into a Chinese regulatory binary.

verified.catalyst: FDA decision on olanzapine extended-release injectable (TEV-'749) for once-monthly schizophrenia treatment, PDUFA anticipated late 2026 following the Feb-20-2026 NDA acceptance (standard 10-month review).
verified.dated_milestone: PDUFA action late 2026 (exact date not publicly disclosed; ~Oct-Dec 2026 implied by Feb-20-2026 acceptance + standard review). Nearest hard date: Q2 earnings Wed 2026-07-29 BMO. EU MAA under EMA review in parallel.
verified.instrument: Common equity (NYSE: TEVA ADR); listed options exist but the binary is too small relative to cap to justify a dated-expiry structure.
verified.bloom_gates: G2 only (concrete commitment: FDA-accepted NDA with a defined statutory review clock). G1 fails (regulator is not a commercial counterparty). G3 fails - no specific currently-unpriced figure; Teva itself guides the combined Uzedy + olanzapine LAI franchise to $1.5-2.0B peak sales, which is public, consensus-embedded, and ~9-12% of a ~$16B revenue base.
verified.primary_source: Teva IR press release, "FDA Accepts Teva's NDA for Olanzapine Extended-Release Injectable Suspension (TEV-'749)," 2026-02-20 (GlobeNewswire release 3242114); supplemented by Teva NDA submission release 2025-12-09 and market data as of 2026-07-05 (price ~$34.64, 52w $14.99-$37.35, mkt cap ~$38.7-40.3B).
verified.analysis: The milestone is real, dated and forward - FDA accepted the TEV-'749 NDA on 2026-02-20 with a standard 10-month clock implying a late-2026 PDUFA, and the EMA accepted the parallel MAA - but it fails the strict gate on materiality and pricing. Peak sales of $1.5-2.0B are for the whole long-acting schizophrenia franchise including already-marketed Uzedy (~$190-200M FY2025, +82% y/y), so the incremental unpriced value on a ~$39B market cap / ~$16B revenue diversified pharma is small, and the stock trading near 52-week highs after more than doubling means the Pivot-to-Growth re-rating has largely occurred. Gap: Teva has not disclosed the exact PDUFA date, so the milestone is a quarter-level rather than day-level marker, which further weakens tradability; no G3 unpriced figure could be established within the lookup budget.

verified.catalyst: T1 Energy must announce a debt-led financing commitment covering the ~$225M remaining Phase 1 capex for the 2.1 GW G2_Austin solar-cell fab, which is targeted to start cell production in Q4-2026.
verified.dated_milestone: Company guided to announcing a commitment in Q2-2026 (Q1 call, 2026-05-12); no announcement found as of 2026-07-20, so the target has slipped. Next dated venue: Q2-2026 results call, expected mid-August 2026; hard backstop = Q4-2026 first cell production at G2_Austin.
verified.instrument: equity (long-dated calls if a levered expression is wanted; the 4.00% converts due 2031 are the credit-linked alternative)
verified.bloom_gates: G2 only — a concrete, company-committed funding milestone with a stated size ($225M) and a stated deadline. G1 fails: the counterparty is described only as "a potential financing counterparty" in diligence, never named. G3 fails: the $225M gap and the Q4-2026 production date are both disclosed and widely covered, so no specific currently-unpriced figure.
verified.edge: L-M — the gap size, the debt-vs-equity preference and the production date are all in the public Q1 release and heavily syndicated; the equity has already run ~+55% on the setup, so the "financing gets done" leg is substantially re-rated. Residual edge is only in the terms (cost/quantum/dilution) and in the fact that the guided Q2 deadline has already been missed without disclosure, which the tape does not appear to be discounting.
verified.primary_source: T1 Energy Q1 2026 results / "T1 Energy Advances G2_Austin Development with Capital Formation Progress", ir.t1energy.com, 2026-05-12 (~$225M Phase 1 requirement, Q2-2026 commitment target, $174.7M convert proceeds); corroborated by ir.t1energy.com bankability release 2026-06-17 (Q4-2026 G2_Austin production) and stocktitan.net/news/TE news feed checked 2026-07-20 (no financing announcement).
verified.analysis: Verified real and specific: after April's upsized $160M 4.00% convertible (net $174.7M), T1 disclosed a residual ~$225M Phase 1 financing requirement for G2_Austin and guided to announcing a debt-heavy commitment in Q2-2026, with first cell production still targeted Q4-2026 (reaffirmed in the 2026-06-17 Intertek CEA bankability release). The catalyst is unfired — no commitment announcement appears in the IR/StockTitan feed through 2026-07-20 — but the guided Q2 window has lapsed, which converts this from a clean binary into a slippage watch, and the +55% move plus a mid-2026 KORE Power acquisition ($32M EV, 2026-06-03) means the funding-success case is largely priced. Not a macro bet; company-specific and financeable, but it stays WATCH rather than ACTIVE because no counterparty is named, no term sheet is public, and the asymmetry has been compressed by the run.

verified.catalyst: Closing of Teleflex's $2.03bn cash sale of Acute Care + Interventional Urology (to Intersurgical Ltd) and OEM (to Montagu/Kohlberg), yielding ~$1.8bn net after-tax proceeds to fund ~$800m debt paydown and a $1bn buyback against a depressed equity.
verified.dated_milestone: Definitive agreements signed 2025-12-09; transactions expected to close in 2H 2026 (regulatory approvals pending). Next dated checkpoint: Q2 2026 results, late July 2026 (Q1 reported 2026-05-07), which should update close timing and buyback pace.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named counterparties: Intersurgical Ltd; Montagu and Kohlberg) + G2 (definitive agreements, $2.03bn cash, ~$1.8bn net); G3 partially — the $1.8bn/$1bn-buyback figures are disclosed and largely public, so not a currently-unpriced number.
verified.edge: L-M — the transaction is publicly disclosed with named buyers and fixed consideration since 2025-12-09; residual edge is only in de-risking of regulatory close and the pace/price of the $1bn repurchase into a depressed tape, not in information asymmetry.
verified.primary_source: Teleflex press release "Teleflex Announces Sale of Acute Care, Interventional Urology, and OEM Businesses for $2.03 Billion" (2025-12-09, investors.teleflex.com / GlobeNewswire; SEC 8-K Ex-99.1, accession 0001193125-25-312941), corroborated by Teleflex Q1 2026 results release (2026-05-07) stating close expected 2H 2026.
verified.analysis: The triage thesis is materially stale in structure: Teleflex abandoned the tax-free RemainCo/NewCo spin framing and on 2025-12-09 signed definitive agreements to SELL Acute Care + Interventional Urology to Intersurgical Ltd (~$530m) and OEM to Montagu/Kohlberg (~$1.5bn), $2.03bn total cash, ~$1.8bn net after tax, closing 2H 2026 — a cash-sale/deleveraging story, not a spin-off arb. The Biotronik vascular acquisition has already closed (Q1 2026 carried $7.8m inventory step-up and $7.8m integration charges), and the divested units were reclassified to discontinued operations in Q4 2025, so the announcement leg has fired and been re-rated; the $1bn buyback was pulled forward and began in Q2 2026. What remains forward is regulatory clearance and proceeds deployment under new CEO Jason Weidman (effective 2026-06-08), plus a real margin overhang (Q1 2026 adj. gross margin -470bp on tariffs and quality remediation) that argues against ACTIVE. Gap: I could not verify a specific announced close date, buyer-side antitrust filing status, or current market cap/price within the lookup budget.

verified.catalyst: FDA PDUFA decision on Telix's resubmitted NDA for TLX101-Px (Pixclara), an F-18 FET PET imaging agent for recurrent/progressive glioma, following a prior Complete Response Letter.
verified.dated_milestone: PDUFA goal date 2026-09-11 (NDA resubmitted 2026-03-13, accepted/announced 2026-04-10); next date = Sept 11, 2026
verified.instrument: common equity (NasdaqGS TLX ADR / ASX:TLX); listed US options exist on the ADR but are thin — equity is the clean expression
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named counterparty: FDA, formal NDA acceptance letter) + G2 (concrete commitment: FDA-assigned PDUFA goal date of Sept 11 2026). G3 FAILS — no specific currently-unpriced figure of consequence; company discloses only a ~24,000 new US glioma cases/yr epidemiology base and gives no revenue quantification.
verified.edge: L — the catalyst is public, well-telegraphed since the April 10 2026 acceptance release, and sell-side already carries the date; the only mild informational edge is that Telix explicitly excludes ALL Pixclara revenue from FY26 guidance, so approval is technically un-modeled in the current year, but the amount at stake is too small to create asymmetry.
verified.primary_source: Telix Pharmaceuticals press release "FDA Accepts NDA for TLX101-Px (Pixclara)", telixpharma.com, 2026-04-10 (also filed as SEC Form 6-K, accession a20260410pixclarandaacce.htm); corroborated by PRNewswire 2026-04-10 and stockanalysis.com quote data 2026-07-15.
verified.analysis: The catalyst is real, specific, dated and genuinely forward — the FDA accepted the Pixclara resubmission on April 10, 2026 and set a hard PDUFA goal date of September 11, 2026, roughly 52 days out, and it has not fired or been re-rated. It is also not a macro bet. What it fails on is magnitude: Telix is now a ~$3.8B commercial-stage company guiding to $950-970M of FY26 revenue off the Illuccix PSMA-PET franchise, while Pixclara addresses only ~24,000 new US glioma cases per year, an opportunity plausibly worth low-to-mid tens of millions at peak — a few percent of the business either way. The one honest positive is that management confirms no Pixclara revenue sits in FY26 guidance, so the upside is un-modeled, but that does not rescue an event whose maximum swing is small relative to the equity, and the prior CRL means the downside tail (second CRL, further delay) is live without being large. WATCH rather than ACTIVE: hold the date, but the payoff geometry does not justify sizing.

verified.catalyst: Telesat launches its first two Lightspeed pathfinder satellites on SpaceX Falcon 9 in December 2026, the first hardware proof-point for a fully funded CAD 2.54B LEO constellation that the equity currently discounts heavily against net debt.
verified.dated_milestone: First two Lightspeed pathfinder satellites launch — December 2026 (company-guided); intermediate checkpoint = Q2 2026 results (Aug 2026) reconfirming date; serial SpaceX launches 2-4 months after pathfinders.
verified.instrument: Common equity (TSAT, Nasdaq); long-dated calls if available given binary, high-vol payoff — position small, event is 5 months out and slippage-prone
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (SpaceX / MDA Space / Government of Canada named), G2 (CAD 2.54B funding agreements closed, 14-launch SpaceX contract), G3 partial (C$1.1B Lightspeed backlog vs discounted equity stub)
verified.edge: L/M — the December 2026 date, the CAD 2.54B funding close, and the 14-launch SpaceX contract are all publicly announced and widely reported (SpaceNews, StockTitan, SpaceQ), so the milestone itself is priced; the only genuine edge is the gap between ~C$2.7B invested to date plus C$1.1B Lightspeed backlog and a deeply discounted equity stub, which is a valuation view rather than an information edge.
verified.primary_source: SpaceNews, "Telesat eyes December 2026 for Lightspeed pathfinder debut" (2026); corroborated by Telesat Q1 2026 results release, GlobeNewswire 2026-05-05 (C$1.1B Lightspeed backlog, C$2.7B invested, Q1 2028 service date) and Telesat press release on completion of CAD 2.54B funding agreements.
verified.analysis: The catalyst is real, dated, forward and not macro: G1 named counterparties (SpaceX Falcon 9 14-launch agreement, MDA Space as prime, Government of Canada/Quebec funding), G2 a concrete commitment (CAD 2.54B funding agreements completed, ~C$2.7B already invested, C$1.0-1.2B 2026 capex guided), and a partial G3 in the C$1.1B Lightspeed backlog disclosed at Q1 2026. What keeps this at WATCH rather than ACTIVE is that a pathfinder launch is a technical demonstration, not a cash-flow or re-rating event — global commercial service already slipped ~3 months to Q1 2028 on ASIC readiness, and revenue is ~18+ months beyond the December date while legacy GEO revenue fell 25% y/y in Q1 2026. Slippage risk is high and the schedule has already moved once, so the December date is best treated as a monitorable checkpoint (reconfirm at Q2 2026 results in August) rather than a fired trigger.

verified.catalyst: Closing of the $12.00/share all-cash CrossCountry Mortgage acquisition of Two Harbors plus a pro-rated stub dividend, pending the last handful of state regulatory approvals.
verified.dated_milestone: Stockholder approval fired 2026-07-02; next date = remaining 5 state regulatory approvals and expected close during August 2026 (federal antitrust cleared May 2026; 48 of 53 state approvals in hand).
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named counterparty: CrossCountry Mortgage) and G2 (concrete commitment: signed merger agreement, $12.00 cash + pro-rated stub dividend, stockholder approval obtained 2026-07-02). G3 FAILS - no specific currently-unpriced figure; the stub dividend is disclosed and the tape already reflects it.
verified.edge: L - stock last 12.09 (bid 12.09 / ask 12.11) against $12.00 cash plus an estimated ~$0.17-0.20 Q3 stub (Q2 dividend was $0.34), i.e. roughly 0.5-0.9% gross to a ~1-month close. Fully re-rated after the vote; the bidding-war optionality is dead.
verified.primary_source: Two Harbors 8-K / press release on stockholder approval, SEC EDGAR CIK 0001465740, filed 2026-07-02; corroborated by Bloomberg 2026-07-02 and HousingWire; live quote from IBKR snapshot 2026-07-20 (last 12.09).
verified.analysis: The event is real, named and dated: TWO holders approved CrossCountry's $12.00 all-cash merger on 2026-07-02, defeating UWM's $12.50 cash/stock bid, with close guided to August 2026 pending five remaining state licence approvals. But the catalyst has substantially fired - shares closed at 12.09, above the headline cash price, so the market is already paying for the stub dividend, leaving perhaps 50-90bp of gross residual against a broken-deal downside of several dollars (asymmetry roughly 1:20). Gap in verification: the exact stub amount is date-dependent and not yet declared, and I did not independently confirm which five states remain, so the estimate is derived from the $0.34 Q2 dividend and a mid-August close assumption.

verified.catalyst: Blackstone Infrastructure's signed $61.25/share all-cash acquisition of TXNM Energy needs only NMPRC and NRC sign-off, and the NMPRC docket restarts once the joint applicants file the PIPE-unwind compliance report due before end-July 2026.
verified.dated_milestone: NMPRC compliance report filing before 2026-07-31 (next hard date), then re-set of the NMPRC procedural schedule; outside date extended to 2027-05-31; company-guided close 1H 2027.
verified.instrument: Common equity, long (merger-arb spread capture; listed options too thin/low-IV to add edge)
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named counterparty: Blackstone Infrastructure Partners) + G2 (concrete commitment: executed merger agreement, $61.25 cash/share, termination date amended to May 31 2027, four of six approvals already granted - PUCT, FERC, FCC, HSR)
verified.edge: M - the deal itself is fully public and the ~6.7% gross spread is visible, but the market is pricing the July 2 NMPRC PIPE-void order as open-ended deal risk when the remedy is already funded and mechanical ($400M term loan drawn, equity issuance to repay); the mispricing is in the probability of NMPRC denial, not in the existence of the catalyst.
verified.primary_source: TXNM Energy / Blackstone Infrastructure joint press release, "TXNM Energy and Blackstone Infrastructure Extend Merger Agreement," 2026-07-17 (PRNewswire, filed as 8-K Ex-99.1); NMPRC PIPE-void order 2026-07-02; price from stockanalysis.com close 2026-07-17.
verified.kill_fact: All load-bearing facts verify against primary/company sources: $61.25/share all-cash Blackstone Infrastructure deal; NMPRC's July 2, 2026 final order voided the 2025 $400M PIPE, imposed $300K aggregate penalties ($100K each on TXNM/Parent/Purchaser) and paused the procedural schedule; a compliance report is due within 45 days with joint applicants intending to file before end-July 2026; TXNM drew a $400M term loan to unwind it; PUCT, FERC (Feb 2026), FCC, HSR and 99.6% shareholder approval are all in hand, leaving only NMPRC and NRC; close $57.41 on 2026-07-17 vs $61.25 = 6.69% gross, dividend $1.69 (2.94% yield) confirmed. CORRECTIONS that cut the score from 7: (1) TIMELINE — on July 17, 2026 (three days before this line was written, and unmentioned in it) the parties extended the outside date to May 31, 2027 and now guide close to H1 2027, so the "~10-month" framing is the optimistic tail of a range the counterparties themselves just widened; ~9% total return over 10-12 months is only ~8-9% annualized against ~13%+ downside to the ~$50 standalone zone, i.e. roughly 1:1.5 risk/reward, not the asymmetry the width implies. (2) EVENT MECHANICS — the compliance filing is a datable filing, not a datable restart: the NMPRC must accept it and re-establish a schedule, and the same commission that voided the PIPE and levied penalties controls that discretion, so the "restarts the docket" claim overstates a one-sided act as a bilateral one. (3) OMITTED OVERHANG — TXNM plans to issue common stock to repay the $400M term loan, a dilution/supply overhang not disclosed in the thesis. Not FIRED (catalyst is forward, end-July 2026), tradeable ($6.4B cap, NYSE common), no hidden disqualifier found. Thesis edge is real but is compensation for genuine New Mexico regulatory hostility rather than mispricing.
verified.analysis: At $57.41 (close 2026-07-17) versus $61.25 cash, the gross spread is 6.7%, roughly 9% including the $1.69 annual dividend over a ~10-month close - unusually wide for a regulated-utility LBO that already holds PUCT, FERC, FCC and HSR clearance. The width is entirely the NMPRC's July 2 order voiding the June 2025 $400M/8M-share Blackstone PIPE at $50.00 and pausing the procedural schedule; TXNM has since drawn a $400M term loan to unwind it and will file a compliance report before end-July, which is the specific, datable event that restarts the docket. Risk is real and asymmetric downside (standalone utility re-rate toward the ~$50 pre-deal zone if NMPRC denies, plus the PIPE episode signals a hostile New Mexico commission), so this is a sized arb rather than a conviction position; NRC transfer approval is the low-risk residual.
